name: AgentCom UK Business Onboarding
one_liner: Show a UK SMB how it appears to ChatGPT, then make the company machine-readable and safely operable through ChatGPT.
core_thesis: The initial sale is not an AI receptionist; it is visibility and operability in the interface customers increasingly use. A business can be represented as a canonical company graph with services, locations, availability, contacts, policies and integrations, then bounded actions can be executed through ChatGPT without exposing credentials.
why_now: SMBs already suffer fragmented admin while agent interfaces are becoming capable of discovery and action.
job: Get discovered accurately in ChatGPT and run calls, leads, bookings, quotes, invoices and admin without juggling software.
distribution: Direct audit/onboarding wedge; reusable vertical templates for plumbers/electricians/barbers/beauty/garages.
moat: CompanyGraph + vertical onboarding DAGs + permissioned tool surface + observed AutonomyRate/bottleneck dataset.
falsifiers: ChatGPT discovery does not drive meaningful customer intent.
SMB onboarding contains too many unavoidable H-tasks to automate economically.
Owners do not trust bounded agent actions even with receipts.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
surviving_value: delegated authority over a real business
software_substitution_test.rationale: OpenAI can write a better business agent but cannot manufacture a proprietor's permission to act for that business or its private operating history.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Acquire one real permission and use it to solve one painful business job
underengineer.minimal_live_product: Onboard one UK trade business, identify its single highest-frequency pain, obtain permission for one channel/action, execute one real bounded workflow, and measure the outcome.

steps.action: Interview/audit one real business and choose exactly one painful workflow
steps.acceptance: Pain, baseline frequency and desired outcome recorded.

steps.action: Obtain explicit delegated permission for the minimum required channel/action
Handle one real case through that channel
steps.acceptance: External action receipt exists and secrets remain hidden.
Outcome is linked to the action and campaign.

underengineer.graduation_rule: One proprietor grants repeatable authority because the workflow produced measurable value.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If owners will not delegate even one consequential action after seeing the audit/value proposition, revisit the wedge.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.
